definitionZh: 文本阴影 CSS 属性在文本中添加阴影 。 它接受一个逗号分隔的阴影列表,用于文本及其任何文本装饰. 每个阴影都由元素的X和Y抵消,模糊半径,和颜色的某种组合来描述.
sourceDefinition: The text-shadow CSS property adds shadows to text. It accepts a comma-separated list of shadows to be applied to the text and any of its text-decoration. Each shadow is described by some combination of X and Y offsets from the element, blur radius, and color.
